waivers.tanning_yard_on_the_outcast_side: Ubame's land falls southwest (down_deg=135), so its pollution geography went west - the burakumin quarter, the execution ground, the cemeteries and the cremation ground are all on that side. Its only tannable water is the valley stream in the EAST, with no watercourse within ~1,000 ft of the quarter, so the yard must sit east and the fall and the water point different ways. A hill valley is allowed to have its low ground and its running water disagree; the map follows both rather than faking one.
